verification_summary.reason: Three substantial institutions/networks returned actual title-query books. Fourteen major priorities and meaningful alternatives were researched; search exclusions, challenge, broken queries/routes and lack of a public holdings endpoint prevent ten verified targets.

market.summary: Angola has distinct national/legal-deposit, municipal public, ReMA multimedia, university and specialist collections. Biblioteca Nacional coordinates the public-library system and has a collective-catalog mandate, but this does not prove a live countrywide holdings union. ReMA has a shared OPAC link and geographical reach; central and regional university libraries remain material targets even where public holdings searches were not found. Portuguese is the primary observed catalog language. No national LMS market-share survey was established.
market.platform_strategy: Start with Portuguese Koha at BNA and Lusíada: both returned exact-title records and holdings; existing app adapter is a reuse candidate, not yet live-tested. The other observed Koha deployments cannot be assumed ready: ISA prohibits search paths, Metodista searches returned zero despite a readable holding, and Parliament returned an origin DNS error. ReMA is the strongest evidenced shared public-network service; one custom POST adapter can potentially reach its branches, but only Luanda holdings were verified and metadata/circulation limitations must be retained. ISPTEC requires a Pergamum public-API adapter and resolution of its observed database error. ISAF documents Nyron but challenges public access; Sol Nascente prohibits its search path. ISPEKA Biblivre 5 is campus-only. No Angolan PMB or SophiA deployment was substantiated; the observed sample does not establish national market share.

limitations: No national largest-ten ranking established. Fourteen substantial institutional/network priorities are not fourteen verified catalogs.
Three observed successful catalog targets, all selected; zero reserves. Ten-target goal has shortfall seven after major institutions and meaningful alternatives were investigated.
A network counts once: Lusíada branches are not separate targets, and ReMA is not counted again as Luanda. Other ReMA branches remain unverified.
Initial proxy failures were a research transport incident. BNA recovered under one bounded policy recheck; original timestamps and control evidence remain.

Robots 404 means no published rule, not permission. ISA/Sol Nascente search exclusions were respected; ISAF challenge, parliamentary DNS failure and ISPTEC query error were not bypassed or repeatedly retried.

Web discovery may be indexed/cached; only direct query responses establish observed title/holding success. Static lists, showcases, repositories and direct record-only evidence do not satisfy the submitted-search target.
Collection dates and units differ: mixed-document titles, volumes/periodicals, physical books, works, capacity and institutional proxies are not combined into a national ranking.

BNA >150,000 figure is mixed-document titles from a 2025 publication, measurement date unknown, indexed official excerpt only. ISPTEC 150,000 is capacity; its PDI 2025–2029 gives 23,734 books / 4,095 titles.

ReMA history lists eight opened mediatecas, menu ten names and catalog sixteen selector entries; none are additive or individually proven. Provincial management transfers require governance reconciliation.
ReMA has malformed ISBN, year, edition and author encoding; title plus Luanda location is verified, but edition identity, copy count and circulation remain unknown.
Observed Koha deployments are a feasibility-selected institutional sample, not national LMS share. No scoped Angolan PMB/SophiA deployment was substantiated, without claiming absence.
Public catalog lookup does not establish visitor admission, borrowing entitlement, metadata reuse permission or future circulation. Observed Available/Disponível labels are time-specific.
No app integration, code/configuration, authentication, outreach, account-state persistence, holds or production changes; every selected live_app_tested is false.
